findings.title: doctor says a newer ai-ctl installed a llama-swap ahead of the pin, which an older ai-ctl's --version installs too
findings.cause: the warning on a release ahead of the pin names one cause, "a newer ai-ctl installed it", and its remedy runs "the newer ai-ctl that installed" it; ai-ctl 0.2.0's `gateway install --version N` installs any release, ahead of 0.3.0's pin included, and a release put in the directory by hand reads the same
findings.consequence: a user of 0.2.0 who ran `ai-ctl gateway install --version 272` once v272 is out, then upgrades to 0.3.0, reads that a newer ai-ctl installed v272 and is told to run it, though none exists
findings.fix: the warning names no cause: the release is ahead of the pin, which this ai-ctl was not tested with; the remedy goes back to the pin, or runs an ai-ctl that pins that release
findings.test: doctor on a current v272: its detail names no newer ai-ctl, its remedy names `ai-ctl gateway install` and an ai-ctl that pins v272
findings.evidence: read: src/application/doctor.rs:192-202 states the cause; 0.2.0's docs/commands.md at `test(chat): read the gateway's chat captured through llama-swap v270` of 2026-11-08, `gateway install --version 264 --sha256 <hex>`, and src/presentation/cli.rs at `test(chat): read the gateway's chat captured through llama-swap v270` of 2026-11-08, `version: Option<Release>` with no bound
findings.fingerprint: the CLI's contract | src/application/doctor.rs + src/application/gateway.rs | Doctor::llama_swap_check + Installer::install
findings.fixed_in: fix(doctor): name no newer ai-ctl for a llama-swap ahead of the pin

findings.title: the guard of a release behind the pin leaves an equivalent mutant
findings.cause: `release < pinned` follows an arm that takes `release == pinned`, so `<=` behaves the same and no test can tell them apart; cargo mutants reports it missed
findings.consequence: none at run time; a missed mutant at each run of the diff's mutants, to be justified by hand
findings.fix: the release compared with the pin once, by `release.cmp(&pinned)`, each of Less, Equal and Greater its own arm, after the arm of a release older than OLDEST
